brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hang on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: Two hex-acc-keyhole accessories installed on back faces (slot 1) of end cells piece:-1,0,0 and piece:1,0,0 as accessory:0#-1,0#1 and accessory:0#1,0#1 – provides two-point lift-and-drop wall mounting.

Three hex-acc-hook plates (each plate carries two hooks) on front faces (slot 4) of all three cells: accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 – total 6 hooks for pliers, screwdrivers, wrenches etc.

finish.summary: 3-cell linear tool rack (pieces at -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 with joint bolts) – keyhole hangers on rear for wall mounting, 3 hook plates (6 hooks) on front for hand tools. MeshClash clear, structurally joined.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
